# StoryMoji

> A colourful, kid-friendly web app for making up stories – a digital take on
> Story Cubes. Draw 1-6 cards, each showing an emoji and its word, and invent
> a story from them.

No backend, no accounts, no cookies or tracking. Bilingual (German/English).
All state (language, sound, current draw) lives in the URL hash or the
browser's local storage.

## Docs

- [Live app](https://storymoji.nichtregistriert.de): the app itself
- [Source code](https://github.com/dasistdaniel/StoryMoji): full source, MIT licensed
- [Privacy policy](https://storymoji.nichtregistriert.de/datenschutz.html): data handling (German, GDPR)
